discovery.finding: Current fal gallery lists Rodin 2.5, Meshy 7.1, Hunyuan3D 3.1 Pro, Tripo H3.1 and TRELLIS.2. No newer suitable multiview endpoint was discovered in this fetched gallery snapshot.
discovery.limit: Availability is verified from current model schemas; catalogue discovery is not a complete market survey or a quality benchmark.

selectedModels.name: Rodin Gen-2.5 Extreme-High
selectedModels.viewSemantics: First supplied image drives material generation. No direction labels exposed in fal schema; send the same front/back/left/top order consistently.
selectedModels.textureLimit: HighPack provides 4K pack textures in fal. Highest exposed texture_mode is high; direct-provider extreme-high/12K texture controls are not exposed.
selectedModels.why: Detailed controlled mesh target, PBR maps and explicit multiview input; retains high-resolution master for inspection.

selectedModels.name: Meshy 7.1 Ultra multiview
selectedModels.viewSemantics: Provider docs: first image is front; remaining order does not matter. Each image must show the same object from a different angle. Use all four supplied roles.
selectedModels.textureLimit: fal schema has PBR control but no texture_resolution. Do not claim provider 8K map output through this endpoint. Multi-image geometry supports 2k, not 4k.
selectedModels.why: Highest documented multiview geometry mode with unremeshed output preserves detail; provider explicitly recommends no remesh for maximum geometry quality.

selectedModels.name: Hunyuan 3D 3.1 Pro
selectedModels.viewSemantics: Explicit front/back/left/top fields match our four turnaround roles. Additional right/bottom/diagonal slots exist but are not invented or supplied.
selectedModels.textureLimit: No texture-resolution guarantee in the inspected fal schema. PBR metallic, roughness and normal maps are requested.
selectedModels.why: Explicit top-view conditioning and highest face-count target provide a complementary reconstruction approach for roof/deck shape and asymmetric geometry.

requestPlan.referenceAudit: Required parent-supplied successful corrected-view audit. null in draft plan intentionally prevents launch.
requestPlan.inputRoles: Rodin and Meshy receive image_urls in front/back/left/top order. Hunyuan receives named input_image_url/back_image_url/left_image_url/top_image_url fields. All models see the same four single-view image crops; no contact sheet and no extra master image.
requestPlan.draftReferenceState: Current approved-lock PNG paths and hashes were checked for the three samples. If the corrected-view pass changes any, parent must refresh the plan and source-lock hash before execution.
requestPlan.hunyuanInputPreflight: Selected PNGs were checked below 8,000,000 bytes each. Final corrected inputs must also satisfy the documented 128-5000 pixel and 8MB image constraints.
requestPlan.timeoutMeaning: Chosen upper wall-clock limit for request handling, not a source measurement or prediction. Submit once; failures propagate rather than submitting a replacement job.
requestPlan.optionalSettingsOmitted: Rodin micro detail and post-enhancement are not enabled merely because they exist: provider notes these can introduce artifacts. Meshy target_polycount/topology are omitted because should_remesh=false causes those fields to be ignored.

tripoH31.reason: The API documents 2-4 images in front/left/back/right order. Our fourth approved turnaround role is top, not right; substituting it would mislabel the view and omit the all-views requirement.

trellis2.reason: Previously verified fal endpoint is single-image. It is outside this requested multiview comparison.

sam3d.finding: The fal schema and Meta README describe one image_url. Multiple masks identify multiple objects in that one image; they do not provide multiview conditioning.
sam3d.finalDisposition: Excluded entirely from execution and comparison by user instruction; no SAM API inference, estimate call or download was made.

falVersusDirectProvider: Rodin direct-provider Gen2.5 documentation describes additional high-poly output and up-to-12K texture modes. Current fal schema does not expose texture_mode extreme-high, uhd_texture or image_label; those controls cannot be promised through this endpoint.

Meshy direct provider supports 8K texture selection. Current fal multiview schema has no texture_resolution field. Its highest multiview geometry resolution is 2k; 4k geometry is only available in a different single-view endpoint.
Hunyuan exposes a maximum face_count of 1,500,000 but no documented texture-size guarantee. Do not infer geometry or texture quality from polygon count alone.
qualityCaveats.rodinHighPackDocumentationDiscrepancy: Current fal helper text mentions approximately 16x Quad geometry for HighPack, while provider Gen2.5 docs state HighPack does not alter geometry. This comparison requests Triangle geometry; actual output counts must be measured.
qualityCaveats.referenceImages: Generated views are design references, not calibrated camera observations. Matching scene appearance does not prove exact metre scale, closed topology or consistent concealed surfaces.
qualityCaveats.capabilityVersusOutcome: Model quality settings and advertised maximum detail are verified capabilities. The proposed model ordering is a workflow choice, not a measured winner.

unrealComparisonRequirements.lighting: Use the approved Unreal lighting profile, recorded with package/config hashes. Do not substitute offline Blender renders for the requested Unreal check.
unrealComparisonRequirements.sameTestConditions: Use matched camera settings, object placement/scale and illumination across model outputs; retain unedited masters and label any import-time correction.
visualReview: Silhouette and proportions against all supplied references
Surface detail, coherent materials and texture seams at both distances
Holes, disconnected or fused thin members, flipped normals and visible UV artifacts
Cabin roof/porch/windows and bridge deck/rails/support connectivity
Boulder broad shape and natural fracture/lichen detail without plastic shading
measuredAssetData: Texture dimensions, channels and file sizes
Actual object bounds and applied scale
Topology/UV diagnostic results with limitations of each automated test
Generation wall time, request ID, published quote and billed actual cost
unrealComparisonRequirements.assetRoutes: This comparison measures image-to-3D output quality. The bridge remains a module, not an engineered full creek span; successful imagery does not replace structural authoring, collision or catalogue height checks.

licensing.classification: Provider-contract outputs; do not relabel them CC0, MIT or Fab Standard. Original input references were user-approved.
licensing.fal: Section 14 restricts competitive development/training using third-party materials/outputs. The inspected text is not an explicit blanket ban on noncompetitive SAR detector inference or simulation evaluation.
licensing.rodin: Hyper3D §5(b) states it will not limit Rodin output use subject to agreements, laws and applicable third-party conditions.
licensing.meshy: Terms include competitive-product, competitive-analysis and competing-AI-training restrictions. Record these faithfully; customer asset-suitability review is not a declaration of unrestricted research rights.
licensing.hunyuan: Commercial-use metadata is present. Broader partner-contract or synthetic-training permissions were not independently resolved and are not claimed.
licensing.privacy: fal API supplement excludes Pending Enterprise Ready models from its input no-training guarantee. Send only public original asset references, without scenario truth or personal data.
